inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A close piece of a pixel art battle stage background: a bright morning sky with white haze over a calm turquoise sea far away, low grey hills in front of the sea, a dark stone obelisk at the left edge. In it, far off: a colossal sea tortoise wading through the far shallow sea, a whole nomad town of the Thundercoast on its high domed shell: small huts of oiled dark blue cloth, little brass domes and masts with blue flags, its old wrinkled head on a long neck, a wild animal, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "one coherent pixel art scene, coherent pixel clusters, a clear readable creature, everything lit by the same light", "lighting": "Clear morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a6ab8", "#8cc0ea", "#e6f2fa", "#8a96a4", "#3ac8c0", "#b03a30", "#c8c2bc", "#a49e9a", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "a bright morning sky with white haze over a calm turquoise sea far away, low grey hills in front of the sea, a dark stone obelisk at the left edge", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [400, 273, 725, 742], "desc": "a colossal sea tortoise wading through the far shallow sea, a whole nomad town of the Thundercoast on its high domed shell: small huts of oiled dark blue cloth, little brass domes and masts with blue flags, its old wrinkled head on a long neck, a wild animal, facing right, wading through the sea, its high domed shell and the town on it above the water, its head raised"}]}}
